ice_recommended_additions.name: EOIR Automated Case Information (hotline and online portal)
ice_recommended_additions.what_it_does: Official US immigration court system. Enter the person's A-number to see the next hearing date, the court, and decision status; works for detained cases too. For bond hearing details, call the immigration court hearing the case.

ice_recommended_additions.name: ICE Online Detainee Locator System
ice_recommended_additions.what_it_does: Official ICE search for a person in ICE custody, by A-number plus country of birth, or by name plus country of birth. Gives the detention facility and its contact information.
ice_recommended_additions.source_url: App comment cites ICE ODLS brochure (checked 2026-10-20); not re-read in this session

ice_recommended_additions.name: EOIR List of Pro Bono Legal Service Providers
ice_recommended_additions.what_it_does: Official list, by state and immigration court, of nonprofit organizations and attorneys who may give free legal services in immigration proceedings. Many entries say whether they take detained cases.
